decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component sprayer extends the firm's core coating know-how into corrosion-protection niches, and with industry turnover growing there is no performance shortfall to trigger problemistic search, so management keeps it despite its modest website presence.
The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established construction-repair offer and has its own product page, so it fits existing capabilities at low cost and meets aspirations.
The material transfer pump builds on near-complete in-house manufacturing and the existing pump platform, and slack in a growing industry lets the firm carry it while its results remain uncertain.
Fire protection flow monitoring has its own product page and supports the firm's digitalization goals, so it matches strategic aspirations and gives no reason to drop it in the first year.
